entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. These cycling shoes.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine. Hold on. It's VF-90210-C.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the order here for the VeloFit Pro-Glide cycling shoes, delivered on October 26th, which was 52 days ago. To make sure I document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They give me blisters. They're awful.
I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference and fit issue?
My preference is to not get blisters. So I want a refund.

Of course, I completely understand. Getting the fit right with new cycling shoes can be tricky, especially with how they interact with the cleats and pedals. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process this return and get you a full refund.
Fine. I guess it's better than being stuck with them.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any postal service location.
I understand. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope we can find a better footwear solution for you in the future. Have a good rest of your day.
